story_title: Lina and Adams and the Music Show
lesson: Learn music and action words in English!
title: Lina and Adams and the Music Show 🎵 | Learn Music Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
The class is getting ready for a music show! Adams feels a little shy, but Lina helps him, and they sing together. 🎵👏💃
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: music, song, sing, clap, dance, jump, loud and soft. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🎵 music — موسيقى / الموسيقى — la musique
🎶 song — أغنية / غنية — la chanson
🎤 sing — يغني / غنّي — chanter
👏 clap — يصفق / صفّق — taper des mains
💃 dance — يرقص / شطح — danser
🦘 jump — يقفز / نقز — sauter
🔊 loud — بصوت عالٍ / جهير — fort
🤫 soft — بصوت خافت / بشوية — doux

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: put on a song at home and play "Simon says" in English: "clap", "jump", "dance", "sing loud", "sing soft". Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات الموسيقى والحركة: يغني، يصفق، يرقص، يقفز.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les mots de la musique : chanter, taper des mains, danser, sauter.

lines.text: It is Monday morning at school. The sun is bright.
On the board, the teacher wrote two big words: Music Show!
Adams, look! On Friday, our class has a music show!
A music show? For our mums and dads?
Music is the happy sound we hear in songs. We can sing it and play it.
Say it with me: music!
I love music. It makes my feet want to move!
The children must choose one song for the show.
Let's sing the song about the moon and the stars!
Yes! I know that song. Twinkle, twinkle!
A song is music with words. We sing a song with our voice.
Can you say it? Song!
Lina and Adams smile. They have a song for the show.
Now we must practise every day!
After school, Lina and Adams go to the park with Milo the cat.
Let's practise our song here, under the big tree.
Lina opens her mouth and sings. La, la, la!
Adams sings very, very quietly. He looks a little shy.
To sing means to make music with your voice.
Say it with me: sing!
Meow, meow! Milo wants to sing too!
Our song needs a little beat. Let's clap our hands!
Clap, clap, clap! Lina claps her hands together.
I can do it too! Clap, clap!
When we clap, we hit our hands together and they make a sound.
Let's say it together: clap!
Can you clap your hands three times? One, two, three!
Meow! Milo cannot clap. He has paws!
A little breeze moves the flowers. They look like they are moving to the music.
Look, Lina! The flowers are dancing!
Let's dance like the flowers! Turn around and move your arms.
Lina and Adams turn, and turn, and wave their arms.
To dance means to move your body to music.
Say it with me: dance!
Dancing is fun! I feel happy!
Back home in the garden, Adams has a new idea.
At the end of the song, we can jump up high!
Lina bends her knees and jumps. Hop! Up into the air!
To jump means to push with your legs and go up into the air.
Can you say it? Jump!
Milo jumps too, right over the ball. Boing!
Ha ha! Milo is the best jumper!
In the evening, they walk home on the street. The sky is orange.
I want to be brave. I will sing very loud! LA, LA, LA!
Milo puts his paws on his ears. Meow!
Oh, Adams, that is very loud! Milo's ears are small.
Loud means a big, strong sound that we hear very well.
Say it with me: loud!
Oops! Sorry, Milo. Not too loud.
At night, Lina sits on her bed with Milo.
Shh, Milo. Now I will sing the song very soft.
Lina sings gently, like a little whisper. Twinkle, twinkle, little star.
Soft means a small, gentle sound. It is the opposite of loud.
Let's say it together, softly: soft.
Milo closes his eyes. Purr, purr. He likes the soft song.
Good night, Milo. Tomorrow is the music show!
Friday is here! All the mums and dads are sitting in the classroom.
Adams holds Lina's hand. His tummy feels funny.
Lina, I am shy. What if I forget the words?
It is okay, Adams. We will sing together, side by side.
If you forget, just clap and smile. I am here with you.
Adams takes a big, slow breath. In, and out.
Okay. Together. Let's do it!
The music starts. Lina and Adams sing the song.
They sing loud, and then they sing soft.
They clap their hands. Clap, clap!
They dance, and turn, and wave their arms.
At the end, they jump up high. Hooray!
I did it! I sang the whole song!
You were wonderful, Adams!
Everybody claps for Lina and Adams. Clap, clap, clap!
Adams feels warm and happy inside.
Thank you for helping me, Lina. You are a good friend.
We are a team! Music is better together.
When a friend feels shy, we can help them with kind words.
Can you remember the song? Let's hum it together. Mmm, mmm.
In the evening, Lina, Adams and Milo sit in the garden.
The sun is going down. The birds are singing too.
Listen, Lina! The birds have a song too.
Everybody loves music, even the birds!
Milo dances around the flowers. Meow, meow!
Let's have another music show next week!
And they all laugh together. What a happy day!
